💥
Units of the Tsentr Group of Forces inflicted damage
on personnel and equipment of four mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, a marine brigade and two national guard brigades near Krutoyarovka in Dnepropetrovsk region, and Belozerskoye, Novoyavlenka, Druzhkovka, Starovarvarovka, Veselaya Gora, Roganskoye, Yuryevka and Gornyak in the Donetsk People's Republic.
⚡️
In Dobropolye
(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army advanced in the north-western part of the city. The Group's assault units continued their offensive in the western part of the settlement.
📊
Over the course of the day, 31 buildings were liberated and up to 15 Ukrainian servicemen were neutralised.
▪️
In total, in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group, the losses of Ukrainian armed formations amounted to up to 345 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units continued to advance to the depths of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted damage on personnel and hardware of two air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and two marine brigades close to Tarasovka, Ivanovka, Kolomiytsy, Chernenkovo, Vasilkovka, and Podgavrilovka in Dnepropetrovsk region, and Mirolyubovka and Rayskoye in Zaporozhye region.
▪️
The Ukrainian Armed Forces lost over 190 troops, six motor vehicles, a Grad MLRS combat vehicle, and an electronic warfare station.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They hit formations of two mechanised brigades and a mountain assault brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces close to Orekhov, Balabino and Kushugum in Zaporozhye region.
▪️
Up to 30 Ukrainian troops and 13 motor vehicles were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops and artillery of the Russian groups of forces
inflicted damage on transport infrastructure used in the interests of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, workshops producing unmanned aerial vehicles and their storage sites, as well as temporary deployment points of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in
145
areas.
▫️
Air defence assets shot down four Flamingo long-range cruise missiles and
342
fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊

the enemy has lost:

674

item.title: ⚡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region are tightening the encirclement and expanding the outer control zone.
🚩
Within the encirclement, as a result of the active actions of our units,
control has been established over the settlements of Nefyodovka and Chernoye in Kharkov region.
💥
Fighting continues for the liberation of Nikolayevka and Varvarovka in Kharkov region.
👊
As part of the expanding of the outer control zone,
fighting continues to establish control over the settlements of Prikolotnoye, Kotovka and Gogino in Kharkov region.
🔥
Fire strikes were delivered against strongholds of a heavy mechanised brigade and an assault regiment of the Ukrainian Armed Forces close to Fedorovka and Maly Burluk in Kharkov region.
💥
Also in Kharkov region,
personnel and equipment of three mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades and two assault regiments of the Ukrainian Armed Forces were hit close to Liptsy, Velikiye Prokhody, Zamulovka, Shirokoye, Zarechnoye, Pershotravnevoye, Kurgannoye, Veliky Burluk, Vysoky and Gontarovka.
🔥
In Sumy region,
formations of a mechanised brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and two territorial defence brigades were hit in the areas of the settlements of Leninskoye, Barilovka and Pervomayskoye in Sumy region.
▪️
In total, in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group the enemy lost over 175 servicemen, 16 motor vehicles and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Zapad Group improved their position along the forward edge.
They inflicted damage on personnel and equipment of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and a territorial defence brigade in the areas of the settlements of Mayaki, Karpovka, and Donetskoye in the Donetsk People's Republic, and Chervony Oskol and Maliyevka in Kharkov region.
▪️
Ukrainian Armed Forces losses amounted to up to 220 servicemen, three armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, three artillery pieces and a Grad MLRS combat vehicle.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted damage on formations of a mechanised brigade, a mountain assault brigade and an airmobile brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in the areas of the settlements of Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Semenovka, Vysokoivanovka, and Krasny Molochar in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 145 servicemen, 33 motor vehicles and two field artillery pieces.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 Andrei Belousov opens summit of CIS Defence Ministers’ Council Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov has opened the meeting of the Council of Defence Ministers of the member s
item.description: Andrei Belousov opens summit of CIS Defence Ministers’ Council Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov has opened the meeting of the Council of Defence Ministers of the member states of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), which is being held in Cholpon-Ata in the Kyrgyz Republic. 💬 In opening the meeting, the head of the Russian military department stated that it is taking place amid a complex military-political situation in the world and along the perimeter of the CIS borders , which requires coordinated action and joint efforts to ensure the security of the CIS countries. 'In this connection, we attach particular importance to enhancing the readiness of the armed forces to respond to emerging challenges and threats. It is on this basis that the agenda of the meeting has been prepared,' noted the Russian Defence Minister. 📑 During the joint work, the attendees will present reports on approaches to building national armed forces, use of new types of weaponry, and current trends in the organisation of operational and combat training , as well as sign documents aimed at improving interaction and strengthening the potential of joint military systems. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Andrei
Belousov opens summit
of CIS Defence Ministers’ Council
Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov has opened the meeting of the Council of Defence Ministers of the member states of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), which is being held in Cholpon-Ata in the Kyrgyz Republic.
💬
In opening the meeting, the head of the Russian military department stated that it is taking place
amid a complex military-political situation in the world and along the perimeter of the CIS borders
, which requires coordinated action and joint efforts to ensure the security of the CIS countries.
'In this connection, we attach particular importance to enhancing the readiness of the armed forces to respond to emerging challenges and threats. It is on this basis that the agenda of the meeting has been prepared,' noted the Russian Defence Minister.
📑
During the joint work,
the attendees will present reports on approaches to building national armed forces, use of new types of weaponry, and current trends in the organisation of operational and combat training
, as well as sign documents aimed at improving interaction and strengthening the potential of joint military systems.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🇷🇺 Russia and Kyrgyzstan approve military cooperation plan for 2027 The cooperation plan between the defence ministries of Russia and Kyrgyzstan for 2027 was signed during a meetin
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇰🇬 Russia and Kyrgyzstan approve military cooperation plan for 2027 The cooperation plan between the defence ministries of Russia and Kyrgyzstan for 2027 was signed during a meeting between the heads of the two countries' military departments. 💬 During the meeting, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov noted that Russian-Kyrgyz military cooperation is developing dynamically. He also emphasised that particular attention in the interaction between the two defence ministries is given to the operational and combat training, personnel education and sharing experience, functioning of the joint Russian military base on the territory of Kyrgyzstan, and military-technical cooperation. 🤝 In turn, Ruslan Mukambetov thanked his Russian counterpart for the assistance provided to the Republic by the Russian Ministry of Defence in strengthening combat readiness of the Kyrgyz Armed Forces, including military and military-technical cooperation, personnel training and other areas of interaction. 👉 He also expressed gratitude to the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation for inviting the Kyrgyz Armed Forces to take part in the recently completed Centre 2026 strategic command post exercise. The talks between the heads of the Russian and Kyrgyz military departments preceded the meeting of the Council of Defence Ministers of the CIS member states. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30051

🇷🇺
🇰🇬
Russia and Kyrgyzstan approve military cooperation plan for 2027
The cooperation plan between the defence ministries of Russia and Kyrgyzstan for 2027 was signed during a meeting between the heads of the two countries' military departments.
💬
During the meeting, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov noted that Russian-Kyrgyz military cooperation
is developing dynamically.
He also emphasised that particular attention in the interaction between the two defence ministries is given to the operational and combat training, personnel education and sharing experience, functioning of the joint Russian military base on the territory of Kyrgyzstan, and military-technical cooperation.
🤝
In turn, Ruslan Mukambetov
thanked his Russian counterpart for the assistance
provided to the Republic by the Russian Ministry of Defence in strengthening combat readiness of the Kyrgyz Armed Forces, including military and military-technical cooperation, personnel training and other areas of interaction.
👉
He also
expressed gratitude to the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation
for inviting the Kyrgyz Armed Forces to take part in the recently completed Centre 2026 strategic command post exercise.
The talks between the heads of the Russian and Kyrgyz military departments preceded the meeting of the Council of Defence Ministers of the CIS member states.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 CIS defence ministers pay tribute to Soviet soldiers in Cholpon-Ata Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov and the heads of delegations of the Council of Defence Ministers of t
item.description: CIS defence ministers pay tribute to Soviet soldiers in Cholpon-Ata 🤝 Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov and the heads of delegations of the Council of Defence Ministers of the member states of the Commonwealth of Independent States laid flowers at the monument to Soviet soldiers in the Central Park of Culture and Recreation in the city of Cholpon-Ata. The participants in the ceremony observed a minute of silence to honour the memory of the soldiers who fell during the Great Patriotic War. The ceremony concluded with a solemn march by a company of the Honour Guard. 🌳 In addition, the defence ministers of the Commonwealth countries took part in a joint tree-planting ceremony. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
